sources.note: Opened; public hospital in Antiguo Cuscatlan; call centre 195; outpatient 7:00-20:30 by appointment; emergencies 'todos los dias, las 24 horas'. Street address only given as a map link.

sources.name: elsalvador.com - how to book at Chivo Pets (2026)

entries.name: Hospital Veterinario Chivo Pets
entries.address: Carretera Panamericana, next to comunidad La Cuchilla, Antiguo Cuscatlan
entries.duty: Emergencies every day, 24 hours. Call centre 195.
entries.note: Address from elsalvador.com 2026 article; official page gives only area plus map link. A 2025 news item reported a presidential order to close Chivo Pets; 2026 articles and the live site show it operating.

notes: Only 3 entries. No official register of the Junta de Vigilancia de la Profesion Medico Veterinaria (CSSP) with a clinic list was found; only regulation PDFs surfaced. No duty rota or animal poison line found. Clinic own sites for Polivetsv, Hospital Veterinario San Francisco, La Sultana, Mascotic, San Miguel Clinica Veterinaria, MEDIVET (Santa Tecla), Animal Life, Hospital Canino Real, TUVET, Veterinaria San Juan, Clinica Gigante could not be surfaced by search (only aggregators vet24.company / happycat.net listed them), and veterinariasanjuan.com / veterinariagigante.com were refused (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED). Presidencia.gob.sv page failed. Nothing found for Santa Ana, San Miguel, El Tunco, Suchitoto, Ruta de las Flores from clinic or official pages. UES clinic (Thursdays 8-12) known only from a 2024 news article.
